name: subScraper-style recon pipeline
description: Authorized recon workflow inspired by subScraper: passive subdomain collection, cleanup, live probing, JSONL technology output, and optional Nuclei/Gobuster/Nikto branches.

data.label: Validate target
data.description: Prepare workspace and validate authorized domain input

config.command:
set -eu
mkdir -p reports
if ! printf '%s' "{domain}" | grep -Eq '^[A-Za-z0-9.-]+$'; then
  echo 'Invalid domain. Use a bare authorized domain such as example.com.' >&2
  exit 2
fi
printf '{"target":"%s","started":"%s","note":"authorized targets only"}\n' "{domain}" "$(date -u +%FT%TZ)" > reports/metadata.json
cat reports/metadata.json

data.label: Passive subdomain collection
data.description: Collect subdomains from subfinder and certificate transparency

data.label: Clean subdomains
data.description: Split, trim, dedupe, and keep hostname-like values

data.label: Has subdomains?
data.description: Only continue if passive enumeration found hosts

data.label: Probe live hosts
data.description: Use curl HEAD requests to find reachable HTTP/S hosts

config.command:
set -eu
node -e 'const input=JSON.parse(process.env.FLOW_INPUT_JSON); const items=input.items||String(input.stdout||"").split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean); console.log(items.join("\n"));' > subdomains.txt
: > live_hosts.txt
: > reports/tech_headers.txt
while IFS= read -r host; do
  [ -n "$host" ] || continue
  for scheme in https http; do
    url="$scheme://$host"
    code=$(curl -k -L -I -sS --max-time 8 -o /tmp/opscanvas_headers.$$ -w '%{http_code}' "$url" 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ "$code" -ge 200 ] 2>/dev/null && [ "$code" -lt 600 ] 2>/dev/null; then
      echo "$url" >> live_hosts.txt
      {
        printf '### %s (%s)\n' "$url" "$code"
        cat /tmp/opscanvas_headers.$$
        printf '\n'
      } >> reports/tech_headers.txt
      break
    fi
  done
done < subdomains.txt
rm -f /tmp/opscanvas_headers.$$
sort -u live_hosts.txt

data.label: Download technology headers
data.description: Save response headers for manual technology review

config.command:
mkdir -p reports
server=$(curl -k -I -sS --max-time 8 "$FLOW_ITEM" 2>/dev/null | awk -F': ' 'tolower($1)=="server"{print $2; exit}' | tr -d '\r')
server=${server:-unknown}
printf '%s\t%s\n' "$FLOW_ITEM" "$server" >> reports/technology.tsv
node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({url:process.argv[1],server:process.argv[2],status:"fingerprinted",timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}))' "$FLOW_ITEM" "$server" >> reports/technology.jsonl

data.label: Prepare technology report
data.description: Create a placeholder technology report when no live hosts exist

config.command:
mkdir -p reports
if [ ! -f reports/technology.tsv ]; then echo 'No live hosts to fingerprint.' > reports/technology.tsv; fi
if [ ! -f reports/technology.jsonl ]; then printf '{"tool":"fingerprint","status":"skipped","reason":"no live hosts","rows":0}\n' > reports/technology.jsonl; fi
cat reports/technology.tsv

data.label: Optional Nuclei scan
data.description: Disabled by default; set run_nuclei=true for authorized targets

config.command:
set -eu
node -e 'const input=JSON.parse(process.env.FLOW_INPUT_JSON); const items=input.items||String(input.stdout||"").split(/\r?\n/).filter(Boolean); console.log(items.join("\n"));' > live_hosts.txt
mkdir -p reports
write_status() { node -e 'console.log(JSON.stringify({tool:process.argv[1],status:process.argv[2],reason:process.argv[3]||"",findings:Number(process.argv[4]||0),timestamp:new Date().toISOString()}))' "$1" "$2" "$3" "$4"; }
if [ ! -s live_hosts.txt ]; then
  write_status nuclei skipped 'no live hosts available' 0 > reports/nuclei.jsonl
  cat reports/nuclei.jsonl
  exit 0
fi
if [ "{run_nuclei}" != "true" ]; then
  write_status nuclei disabled 'set run_nuclei=true for authorized targets' 0 > reports/nuclei.jsonl
  cat reports/nuclei.jsonl
  exit 0
fi
if command -v nuclei >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  nuclei -l live_hosts.txt -severity "{nuclei_severity}" -jsonl -o reports/nuclei.jsonl || true
  if [ ! -s reports/nuclei.jsonl ]; then write_status nuclei completed 'no findings returned' 0 > reports/nuclei.jsonl; fi
else
  write_status nuclei missing 'nuclei not installed in this runtime' 0 > reports/nuclei.jsonl
fi
cat reports/nuclei.jsonl

mkdir -p reports/gobuster
if [ "{run_gobuster}" != "true" ]; then exit 0; fi
if ! command -v gobuster >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'gobuster not installed' >> reports/gobuster.txt; exit 0; fi
safe=$(printf '%s' "$FLOW_ITEM" | tr '/:?' '___')
gobuster dir -u "$FLOW_ITEM" -w "{wordlist}" -q -o "reports/gobuster/$safe.txt" || true

mkdir -p reports/gobuster
if [ "{run_gobuster}" != "true" ]; then echo 'Gobuster disabled. Set run_gobuster=true for authorized targets.' > reports/gobuster.txt; cat reports/gobuster.txt; exit 0; fi
cat reports/gobuster/*.txt > reports/gobuster.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 'No gobuster findings or reports.' > reports/gobuster.txt
cat reports/gobuster.txt

mkdir -p reports/nikto
if [ "{run_nikto}" != "true" ]; then exit 0; fi
if ! command -v nikto >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'nikto not installed' >> reports/nikto.txt; exit 0; fi
safe=$(printf '%s' "$FLOW_ITEM" | tr '/:?' '___')
nikto -host "$FLOW_ITEM" -nointeractive -output "reports/nikto/$safe.txt" || true

mkdir -p reports/nikto
if [ "{run_nikto}" != "true" ]; then echo 'Nikto disabled. Set run_nikto=true for authorized targets.' > reports/nikto.txt; cat reports/nikto.txt; exit 0; fi
cat reports/nikto/*.txt > reports/nikto.txt 2>/dev/null || echo 'No nikto findings or reports.' > reports/nikto.txt
cat reports/nikto.txt

data.label: Download technology JSONL
data.description: Save URL/server-header mapping as JSONL for table preview
